'''2020 Online Championship Series Playoffs''' was the Players Committee OCS playoff on GEMP. [[Justin Desai]] defeated [[Paul Myers]] in the Final Confrontation.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2022-online-championship-series-registration-opens/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' GEMP
* '''Dates:''' October–November 2020
* '''GEMP importable decks:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/major-event-winners/ forum]
